scripts.translation: - 这里有一种奇怪的扭曲 -

scripts.text: Extend your hand.
scripts.translation: 伸出手

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text: - I extend my arm as a fierce sound resonates in my ear and a cool wave surrounds me -
scripts.translation: - 我伸出手臂，耳边响起一阵剧烈的声响，一股凉意将我包围 -

scripts.text: - You ignore the distortion. -
scripts.translation: - 你无视了这种扭曲。 -

scripts.text: - There is a strange distortion here -
scripts.translation: - 这里有一种奇怪的扭曲 -

scripts.text: Search the area.
scripts.translation: 搜索周围

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text: - There appears to be nothing here. But I can definitely feel something around here... -
scripts.translation: - 这里似乎什么都没有。但我确实能感觉到周围有什么东西... -

scripts.text: Extend arm.
scripts.translation: 伸出手臂

scripts.text: Leave it alone.
scripts.translation: 先放着吧。

scripts.text: - I extend my arm as a fierce sound resonates in my ear and a cool wave surrounds me -
scripts.translation: - 我伸出手臂，耳边响起一阵剧烈的声响，一股凉意将我包围 -

scripts.text: - You decide to leave it alone. -
scripts.translation: - 你决定不管它。 -

scripts.text: - You ignore it. -
scripts.translation: - 你无视了它。 -

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Huh!!! Human!?!
How did you enter here?
This is only connected with a special gate!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
什...什么？！人类？！
你是怎么进来的？
这里只有通过特殊的门才能连接！

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
I don't know how...
But we should leave before my master spots you...!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
我不知道...
但我们得趁师父发现你之前离开...！

scripts.text:
[???]
What's that noise out there?
I warned them to be quiet while I'm meditating.
scripts.translation:
[???]
外面那是什么声音？
我明明警告过你们，我冥想时要保持安静。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Huh!?!
Master...
It's nothing...
scripts.translation:
[助手]
什...什么？！
师父...
没什么事...

scripts.text:
[Master]
Oh~ there's a human being in front of me.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
哦~ 我面前有个人类。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Oh this thing?
I was just leading it out.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
哦，那个啊？
我正准备把它带出去。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Yoop!!!
scripts.translation:
[师父]
尤普！！！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Yeap...!!

[Master]
There's the warp portal beyond you... Is it an illusion?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
你身后有个传送之阵... 那是<黑暗搜集者>幻觉吗？

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Sorry!!!
It's my mistake...
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
对不起！！！
是我的错...

scripts.text:
[Master]
Fool...
I'll deal with you after you send the human away.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
蠢货...
等你把人类送走，我再收拾你。

scripts.text:
[Master]
MushSartas Ir Cyamar
UdenLo
scripts.translation:
[师父]
MushSartas Ir Cyamar
UdenLo

scripts.text:
- The fairy with the green hair chants a spell. - 
 - I feel like something special surrounds me. -
scripts.translation:
- 绿发妖精吟唱着咒语。 - 
 - 我感觉有什么特别的东西环绕着我。 -

scripts.text:
[Master]
Oh, that's interesting.
How dare you resist me human?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
哦，这很有趣。
人类，你竟敢反抗我？

scripts.text: I'm not sure. Who are you?
scripts.translation: 我不确定。你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Master]
I am the leader of the ^000077Warlock^000000s.
'^000077Sila Egnoloria^000000'
If you are a Wizard, it would be good of you to memorize my name.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
我是^000077大魔导士^000000的首领。
'^000077艾格诺洛莉亚^000000'
如果你是巫师，最好记住我的名字。

scripts.text: What is a ^000077Warlock^000000?

[Master Egnoloria]
Oh...are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
哦...你有兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
A ^000077Warlock^000000 is someone who uses the magic of the giants of Jotunheim.
It can't be defined in any other words.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
^000077大魔导士^000000是运用约顿海姆巨人魔法的人。
无法用其他词语来定义。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Only the strong magic can explain it.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
只有强大的魔法才能解释它。

scripts.text: Could I become Warlock?
scripts.translation: 我可以成为大魔导士吗？

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
You?
You want to become a Warlock?
Hahaha
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
你？
你想成为大魔导士？
哈哈哈

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
You're so interesting.
It would be difficult for a human to become a Warlock.
The strong power would gnaw at your weak body.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
你很有趣。
人类要成为大魔导士是很困难的。
强大的力量会侵蚀你脆弱的身体。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
If you dare to face death, you can try to become one.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
如果你敢面对死亡，你可以尝试成为大魔导士。

scripts.text: What do I need to do?
scripts.translation: 我需要做什么？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Are you serious?
You hunger for power don't you human.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
你是认真的吗？
你渴望力量，不是吗，人类。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
The strong desire to be more powerful makes your soul more beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
渴望变得更强大的强烈欲望，会让你的灵魂更加美丽。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
But, I need to check that you're qualified.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
但是，我需要检查你是否符合条件。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Yoop!
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
尤普！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Yeap!!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
耶！！

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Give this to the human.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
把这个给人类。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Talk to the guy with the weird hair.
He'll let you know what you should do.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
去和那个头发奇怪的人谈谈。
他会告诉你该怎么做。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Good.
You are a human being so that's for you.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
很好。
你是人类，所以这是给你的。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You're still quite far too low of a level to even consider this.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
你的等级还太低了，根本不够资格考虑这件事。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
You're... we've met before.
Can you imagine how severely I was scolded by my master?!
If you have any business with me, just go away!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你...我们以前见过。
你能想象我被师父骂得多惨吗？！
如果你有什么事找我，就请走吧！

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: Stay.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Leave me alone...!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
别烦我...

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
What?!
Just do whatever you want...
My master will deal with you then.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
什么？！
随你便...
到时候师父会处理你的。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Dear, master! My pony-tail is funny looking?!
Oh, but I spent a lot time on it!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
亲爱的师父！我的马尾辫看起来很滑稽吗？！
啊，但我花了很多时间打理它呢！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
First, use all of your remaining job skill points before continuing.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
首先，在继续之前，请用完你剩余的职业技能点。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
This is the Master's
decision so let me know.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
这是师父的决定，所以请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
It's noisy.
I need to meditate
so do as I said.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
太吵了。
我需要冥想，所以照我说的做。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Huh..
Oh, yeah!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
嗯..
哦，对了！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Hey, human!
Would you like to
become a Warlock?
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
嘿，人类！
你想成为大魔导士吗？

scripts.text: First, use all of your remaining job skill points before continuing.
scripts.translation: 首先，在继续之前，请用完你剩余的职业技能点。

scripts.text:
This is the Master's
decision so let me know.
scripts.translation: 这是师父的决定，所以请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
We need to test if your body can withstand being a Warlock.
So you need to gather materials to prove yourself.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我们需要测试你的身体是否能承受成为大魔导士的负担。
所以你需要收集材料来证明你自己。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Please gather ^000077Glittering Crystal^000000s and ^000077Giant Bradium Fragment^000000s.

[Yoop]
I can't conduct the task here. I need to go to my lab.
My lab is located on the north western part of Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我不能在这里进行任务。我需要去我的实验室。
我的实验室位于辉煌领域的西北部分。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
This stone is well made.
Please go to my Master.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
这块石头制作得很好。
请去找我的师父。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
A Magic Chamber is created from magic materials.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
魔法室是由魔法材料制成的。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
This combined stone is formed differently according to the raw materials and the way of treating it.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
这种组合石会根据原材料和处理方式的不同而呈现出不同的形态。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
But most of stones are quite similar!
We can't differentiate them easily.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
但大多数石头的样子都很相似！
我们很难轻易区分它们。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Even I don't know how it all works.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
连我自己也不知道这到底是怎么运作的。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
You must be wearing these Magical Stone Rings to get these items while hunting.
You need to hunt Naga and Bradium Golems while wearing these rings.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你必须佩戴这些轮回之石戒指，才能在狩猎时获得这些物品。
你需要佩戴这些戒指去狩猎那迦和沉醉于魔力的石锤巨人。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Show us how strong you are. And don't forget to wear this.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
让我们看看你的实力有多强。别忘了佩戴这个。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Bring these stones with you or else you won't be able to return!
Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
把这些石头带上，否则你将无法返回！
小心！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
The person next to my Master will let you out if you talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我师父旁边的人会放你出去的，只要你跟他说话。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
My lab is located on the north western part of Splendide. Bring these to me when you've gathered them.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我的实验室位于辉煌领域的西北部分。收集好后请把这些带给我。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Who are you?
Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你是谁？
给我出去！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
You're back?
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你回来了？

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
I am focusing on meditating.
So I can create magic.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我正在专心冥想。
这样我才能施展魔法。

scripts.text: I brought the materials.
scripts.translation: 我带来了材料

scripts.text: I've lost the Magical Stones.
scripts.translation: 我弄丢了轮回之石

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
......
......Where?
Don't bother me!

[Yoop]
Bring me back the magical stones.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
把那些魔法石头带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
It seems that you don't have it?
You lost it?
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
看来你没有带在身上？
你把它弄丢了？

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Alright! All the materials are ready!
While I am concentrating on working on this stone. Can you go back to my master?
I will follow up once it's done.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
太好了！所有材料都准备好了！
在我专心处理这块石头的时候，你能去见见我的师父吗？
完成后我会去找他。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
[Yoop]
What?!
I asked you to double check it and make sure you wore it!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
什么？！
我让你仔细检查并确保你佩戴了它！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
We need to test if your body can withstand being a Warlock.
So you need to gather materials to prove yourself.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我们需要测试你的身体是否能承受成为大魔导士的负担。
所以你需要收集材料来证明你自己。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Please gather ^000077Glittering Crystal^000000s and ^000077Giant Bradium Fragment^000000s.

[Yoop]
You must be wearing these Magical Stone Rings to get these items while hunting.
You need to hunt Naga and Bradium Golems while wearing these rings.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你必须佩戴这些轮回之石戒指，才能在狩猎时获得这些物品。
你需要佩戴这些戒指去狩猎那迦和沉醉于魔力的石锤巨人。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Bring these stones with you or else you won't be able to return!
Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
把这些石头带上，否则你将无法返回！
小心！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Please find that stone and come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
请找到那块石头，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
What?!
I asked you to double check it and make sure you wore it!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
什么？！
我让你仔细检查并确保你佩戴了它！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Please check whether you misplaced it or if you already have it equipped.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
请检查是否放错了地方，或者是否已经装备上了。

scripts.text: I found it.
scripts.translation: 我找到了。

scripts.text: Nah.
scripts.translation: 不了。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Don't tease me!
It's not hard to tell if you have it or not!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
别逗我了！
你身上有没有，我一眼就能看出来！

scripts.text: Give 3 carat diamond.
scripts.translation: 交出3克拉钻石。

scripts.text: Just quit it.
scripts.translation: 别闹了。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
I will overlook your fault.
Please be careful with it.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我就原谅你这次吧。
请小心保管它。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Just show me your good faith!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
请拿出你的诚意！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
How can you can say that?
^000077Just apologize^000000!
I guess I could give you more stones if you give me say a 3 carat diamond...
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你怎么能这么说？
^000077快道歉^000000！
如果你给我一块3克拉的钻石...我想我可以多给你一些石头...

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Please check your equipment window...
You sure you don't have it?
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
请检查你的装备栏...
你确定你没有吗？

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Then what's that you are holding now...?
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
那你现在手里拿的是什么...？

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
What...?
Don't bother me, I am quite busy.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
什么...？
别烦我，我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
And... you seem to have more talent on this than regular mages.
Maybe if I become an alchemist, I might be better than I am now don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
而且...你在这方面似乎比普通的魔法师更有天赋。
也许如果我成为炼金术士，会比现在更强，你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
I'm studying to better myself.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我正在努力学习，让自己变得更强。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
If am inside of 'the room of time and magic', I will catch up with your power!
Hahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
如果我在“时间与魔法的房间”里，一定能追上你的力量！
哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Human! What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
人类！你想干什么？

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
It's not me you are looking for currently.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
你现在找的不是我。

scripts.text:
You're carring out too many items.
You'd better minimize your weight.
scripts.translation:
你携带的物品太多了。
最好减轻一下负重。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
The test isn't that hard.
We can create the magic stone in the magic room.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
测试没那么难。
我们可以在魔法房间里制作魔法之石。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Be careful of the monsters in the test room.
These are rainbow Rubies sealed with a Warlock's magic.
Use these during the test.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
小心测试房间里的魔物。
这些是用大魔导士的魔法封印的彩虹红宝石。
在测试中使用这些。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
I will guide you into the magic room.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我会引导你进入魔法房间。

scripts.text:
You're carring out too many items.
You'd better minimize your weight.
scripts.translation:
你携带的物品太多了。
最好减轻一下负重。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Would you like to try it again?
Let me give you more rubies.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你想再试一次吗？
让我再给你一些红宝石。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
You have successfully crystallized the Hollow Stone.
I'm sorry that I've doubted you.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你成功地将空洞之石结晶化了。
抱歉，我之前怀疑了你。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
All of the tests are done. Now talk to Master Engoloria.
I'm so happy that you have succeeded.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
所有测试都完成了。现在去和艾格诺洛莉亚大师谈谈吧。
你成功了，我真高兴。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
All of the tests are done. Now talk to Master Engoloria.
I'm so happy that you have succeeded.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
所有测试都完成了。现在去和艾格诺洛莉亚大师谈谈吧。
你成功了，我真高兴。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
I can feel that you have strong magic.
I envy you.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我能感觉到你拥有强大的魔力。
我真羡慕你。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
It deserves something special.
Don't abuse it.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
它值得拥有特别的东西。
不要滥用它。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
......
If you don't have anything to say to me, would you just leave?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
......
如果你没什么要对我说的，请离开好吗？

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
......
I don't have a pony-tail...
scripts.translation:
[助手]
......
我没有扎马尾辫...

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
......
Please be quiet while my master is meditating.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
......
请保持安静，师父正在冥想。

scripts.text: Leave
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: Stay
scripts.translation: 停牌

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Then be careful.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
那么请小心。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
......

[Master Egnoloria]
Do you have something to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
你有什么想问我的吗？

scripts.text: How can I be a Warlock?
scripts.translation: 如何成为大魔导士？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Are you serious?
You hunger for power don't you human.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
你是认真的吗？
你渴望力量，不是吗，人类。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
The strong desire to be more powerful makes your soul more beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
渴望变得更强大的强烈欲望，会让你的灵魂更加美丽。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
But, I need to check that you're qualified.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
但是，我需要检查你是否符合条件。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Yoop!
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
尤普！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Yeap!!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
耶！！

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Give this to the human.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
把这个给人类。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Talk to the guy with the weird hair.
He'll let you know what you should do.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
去和那个头发奇怪的人谈谈。
他会告诉你该怎么做。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Good.
You are a human being so that's for you.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
很好。
你是人类，所以这是给你的。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
I'm meditating, I said talk to Yoop ok.
Yoop has a funny pony-tail.
And don't disturb me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
我在冥想，我说过找尤普。
尤普有个有趣的马尾辫。
别打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
......
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
......

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Master is meditating.
Be quiet.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
师父正在冥想。
请保持安静。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
I've heard from Yoop that a very useful stone can be created.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
我从尤普那里听说可以制作一种非常有用的石头。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
It can be used to make magical jewelry that can cast powerful magic.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
它可以用来制作能施展强大魔法的魔法饰品。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Yoop.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
尤普。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Yeap, Master!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
是的，师父！

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Please take him to the magical room.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
请带他去魔法房间。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Yup, Master.
Please follow me.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
好的，师父。
请跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
......
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
......

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
My master is meditating now, please follow me.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
师父正在冥想，请跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Hm...?
How did you come this far...
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
嗯...？
你是怎么走到这里的...

scripts.text:
You've got too many items.
Please come back after reducing the number of items you have.
scripts.translation:
你携带的物品太多了。
请减少物品数量后再来。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Unless you like your current job, you should use all your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
除非你满意当前的职业，否则你应该使用所有的技能点。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
You are on a riding pet,
so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
你正骑着宠物，
所以无法转职。
请卸下坐骑后再试一次！

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Beautiful light...
Don't make me disappointed at you...
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
美丽的光芒...
不要让我对你失望...

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
You have become a member of the Warlocks.
Be proud.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
你已成为大魔导士的一员。
请为此感到自豪。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou still have left the skill points, Please use all the skill points and try to start again!^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你还有剩余的技能点，请使用完所有技能点后再试一次！^000000

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
This crystallized magical stone will keep you safe.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
这块结晶化的魔法石会保护你的安全。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
How are you adjusting to the power of a Warlocks?
If you get careless, you will be overthrown by your own power.
scripts.translation:
[艾格诺洛莉亚大师]
你适应大魔导士的力量了吗？
如果你变得大意，就会被自己的力量所吞噬。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
If you ask Ebein to be sent to the magical room, he would send you there.
Wait in the queue to enter the Chamber of Magic.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
如果你让埃贝因把你送到魔法房间，他会把你送过去。
请在队列中等待进入魔法室。

scripts.text:
[Ebein]
Would you like to take a test?
If you stand by in the waiting room, you'll be able to go into the Chamber of Magic.
scripts.translation:
[埃贝因]
你想参加测试吗？
如果你站在等候室，就可以进入魔法室。

scripts.text:
[Ebein]
If there're others inside the room, you just need to wait for a while.
scripts.translation:
[埃贝因]
如果房间里还有其他人，你只需要稍等片刻。

scripts.text: Go to the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 去等候室

scripts.text: Go outside.
scripts.translation: 出去

scripts.text:
[Ebein]
Then please enter the room yourself.
Make sure you have enough potions to survive the test as the monsters are very powerful in the Chamber.
scripts.translation:
[埃贝因]
那么请自己进入房间。
确保你有足够的药水来通过测试，因为房间里的魔物非常强大。

scripts.text:
[Ebein]
......
Then I will send you outside.
Bye...
scripts.translation:
[埃贝因]
......
那么我会把你送出去。
再见...
